title: Cut and publish 0.4.4 (LCLI-432 --workspace, LCLI-447/448/449 fixes)
description: User approved cutting 0.4.4 now (2026-09-05) per the orchestrator's recommendation, so opum-agent can pick up the qualified-reference bare-mode fix without waiting, and to prove the plugin.json version-sync fix (LCLI-447) actually works at a real tag. Carries: LCLI-432 (lore agent context --workspace/--repository, the cross-repository evidence-pack feature, PLAN.md 4.6), LCLI-447 (plugin.json now bumped alongside package.json, plus a test that fails if they ever disagree again), LCLI-448 (agent context --workspace's skipped-members banner scoped to --repository, found dogfooding LCLI-432 for real against opum-doc's opum-family manifest), LCLI-449 (agent context no longer crashes uncaught on a qualified reference compiled bare, found live by opum-agent). Follows docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md Step 3 exactly as done for 0.4.1/0.4.2/0.4.3, now including the new plugin.json bump step.
